content_sections.heading: DSLSA Winter Internship Program-2026-27 Overview
content_sections.text: This is an internship program of a government legal services authority, not a regular post. It gives law students first-hand experience of the day-to-day operations of DSLSA and of the Free Legal Aid System. The official notification does not specify the age limit, the pay or stipend, or the application fee.

content_sections.heading: About DSLSA
content_sections.text: Delhi State Legal Services Authority describes itself as working towards "Access to Justice for all" through "Sewa Samadhan Samarpan". Its internship program aims to give students hands-on experience of legal issues faced by people at large, and to reach the marginalised sections of society with awareness of welfare schemes and of the functioning of DSLSA/NALSA.

content_sections.text: DSLSA has announced a total of 200 seats for the Winter Internship Program-2026-27. The notice prints no break-up by category or department.

content_sections.heading: DSLSA Winter Internship Program-2026-27 Eligibility Criteria 2026
content_sections.text: Skills required, as printed in the notice: Efficiency in written Communication (English) Legal writing Basic legal knowledge Computer Operation in Word/Excel/PPT The notice invites law students of various Law Universities/Colleges of India. It also says DSLSA welcomes students who are motivated, socially active, have a positive attitude, take initiative and have empathy to work for different sections of society. Candidates should check the official notification for the full eligibility details.

rows.qualification_required: Law students pursuing Five years Course and Three Years Course are eligible to apply

content_sections.heading: DSLSA Winter Internship Program-2026-27 Selection Process 2026
content_sections.text: Students are selected by "appropriate criteria" if more than the required number of applications are received. The notice does not describe the criteria. Shortlisted students are informed by e-mail (the notice gives 21 December 2026 against this stage). Students must send a confirmation e-mail of their participation to [email protected] by 23 December 2026. Otherwise their application is liable to be rejected.

content_sections.heading: DSLSA Winter Internship Program-2026-27 Internship Details
content_sections.text: The internship period is 08 January 2027 to 28 January 2027. While interning, students may have an opportunity to visit the following authorities and places: Courts and Tribunals: District Courts (Civil and Criminal side); Family Courts; Special Courts dealing with cases under Section 138 N.I.Act; Mediation Centre; Labour Courts and Tribunals including Armed Forces Tribunal, Debt Recovery Tribunal, MCD Appellate Tribunal, Consumer Forums etc.; Permanent Lok Adalat Outreach Activities: Door to Door Campaign in Districts; Legal Services Clinics Child Care Institutions: Observation Homes for Juveniles; Juvenile Justice Boards; Children Homes and Child Welfare Committees Jail and Police Stations: Tihar or Rohini Jails; Police Stations/Forensic Science Laboratory Other Government Establishments: National Commission for Protection of Child Rights Mental Health Institution (IHBAS); One Stop Centers; Shelter Homes in Districts; District Magistrate Offices; District Labour Offices An Internship Certificate is awarded after successful completion of the internship. Three Excellence Certificates are also to be awarded to chosen candidates who complete the internship with sincerity and devotion and bring new innovative ideas. A minimum of 75% attendance is a must for getting the Internship Certificate.

content_sections.heading: How to Apply Online for DSLSA Winter Internship Program-2026-27
content_sections.text: Go to DSLSA's official website, www.dslsa.org , to apply online for the Winter Internship Program-2026-27. The application opens on 1 December 2026 from 10:00 AM. Submit the application with a scanned copy of the Identity Card issued by the College/University. Attach a passport size photograph of the applicant. Attach the letter issued by the Principal/HOD of the Law Department. Submit the application by 15 December 2026, 5:00 PM. If shortlisted, send a confirmation e-mail to [email protected] by 23 December 2026.

content_sections.heading: DSLSA Winter Internship Program-2026-27 Important Instructions
content_sections.text: If the desired documents are not attached, the application will not be considered. Failure to send the confirmation e-mail by 23 December 2026 makes the application liable to be rejected. Selection by "appropriate criteria" applies only if more applications than required are received. Minimum 75% attendance is a must for getting the Internship Certificate.

faq.question: Q1. How many seats are there in the DSLSA Winter Internship Program-2026-27?
Q2. When do applications for the DSLSA Winter Internship start?
faq.answer: Online applications start on 1 December 2026 from 10:00 AM onwards at www.dslsa.org.

faq.question: Q3. What is the last date to apply for the DSLSA Winter Internship?
faq.answer: The last date for submission of applications is 15 December 2026, till 5:00 PM.

faq.question: Q4. Who can apply for the DSLSA Winter Internship Program-2026-27?
faq.answer: Law students pursuing the Five years Course or the Three Years Course can apply.

faq.question: Q5. Which documents are needed with the application?
faq.answer: The application needs a scanned copy of the College/University Identity Card, a passport size photograph and a letter issued by the Principal/HOD of the Law Department. Without these documents the application will not be considered.

faq.question: Q6. How are students selected for the DSLSA internship?
faq.answer: If more than the required number of applications are received, students are selected by appropriate criteria. Shortlisted students are informed by e-mail.

faq.question: Q7. What is the deadline for the confirmation e-mail?
faq.answer: Shortlisted students must send a confirmation e-mail to [email protected] by 23 December 2026, otherwise the application is liable to be rejected.

faq.question: Q8. What are the dates of the internship period?
faq.answer: The internship runs from 08 January 2027 to 28 January 2027.

faq.question: Q9. What attendance is needed for the Internship Certificate?
faq.answer: A minimum of 75% attendance is a must to get the Internship Certificate. Three Excellence Certificates are also to be awarded to chosen candidates.
